Описательная выборка опубликованных вака: A descriptive sample of explicitly selected published jobs; duplicates are merged only when strict identifiers match. Salaries are grouped separately by currency, pay period and gross, net or unknown tax basis; currencies and periods are not converted. Lower and upper bounds are calculated separately; midpoints are calculated only for closed ranges. Quartiles use linear interpolation at (n - 1) * p. Counts refer to unique jobs except for observations and duplicates; each job is counted under all of its sources, so source totals may exceed the job count. Terms for a group of duplicates come from the first selected observation; all original observations are retained. The sample does not estimate the entire market, actual pay, market trends or hiring probability.
